CREATE TABLE idempotency_keys ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, merchant_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, idempotency_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, request_hash VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, response_code INT NOT NULL, response_body JSON, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL );
ALTER TABLE idempotency_keys ADD CONSTRAINT uk_merchant_idempotency_key UNIQUE (merchant_id, idempotency_key);
